name: One word per feature, colour-coded
looks: A single bold lower-case word fills the frame with a full stop and a small accent dot beside it, on a flat ground whose colour changes with the feature's category. A tiny UI prop appears underneath a beat later, just enough to show the word in action: a tooltip bubble with a step counter, a small toggle, a search field. Hard cut to the next word, next colour, next prop.
build: One word per card, set in a heavy grotesk at huge scale, with the trailing period and a small circular accent dot sitting at baseline to its right. Background colour is a fixed palette per category (near-black, cobalt, off-white, teal) that never repeats back-to-back. The UI prop fades/rises in (`y: 10px -> 0`) 200-300ms after the word lands, then holds until the hard cut.
sound: A short, dry hit on every hard cut, pitched slightly differently per card so the run has melodic shape rather than repeating the same note.
prompt: Name each feature as a single bold word filling the frame, a full stop and a small accent dot beside it, the background colour changing by category. A beat after each word lands, drop in one small, real UI control that embodies it, then hard-cut straight to the next word on a clean rhythm.
